description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, civil / nautical / astronomical twilight, golden hour and blue hour for any place and date (NOAA solar calculator equations, about a minute of accuracy), with polar day / night handling, observer elevation correction and local times in any IANA zone. Optionally the sun's azimuth and elevation (refraction-corrected) at a given moment. Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sun-times

at.description: ISO 8601 moment for sun position (azimuth / elevation), or "now"

date.description: Local date YYYY-MM-DD (default today in tz)

elevation.description: Observer height above the horizon in metres (earlier sunrise / later sunset)

tz.description: IANA time zone for the output

name: sun_times
title: Sun Times
